description: This file implements the SpdyWriteQueue class, managing a queue of SPDY protocol frames for network streams, including enqueueing, dequeueing, removing, and changing priorities of writes.

classes.name: SpdyWriteQueue::PendingWrite
classes.description: Represents a pending SPDY frame write, including frame type, producer, associated stream, and traffic annotation.

methods.name: IsSpdyFrameTypeWriteCapped
methods.description: Checks if a given SPDY frame type is write-capped.

methods.name: SpdyWriteQueue::PendingWrite(spdy::SpdyFrameType, std::unique_ptr<SpdyBufferProducer>, const base::WeakPtr<SpdyStream>&, const MutableNetworkTrafficAnnotationTag&)
methods.description: Parameterized constructor initializing a pending write with frame type, producer, stream, and traffic annotation.

methods.name: ~SpdyWriteQueue()
methods.description: Destructor for SpdyWriteQueue, clears the queue.

methods.name: IsEmpty()
methods.description: Checks if the queue is empty across all priorities.

methods.name: Enqueue(RequestPriority, spdy::SpdyFrameType, std::unique_ptr<SpdyBufferProducer>, const base::WeakPtr<SpdyStream>&, const NetworkTrafficAnnotationTag&)
methods.description: Adds a new SPDY frame to the queue with specified priority and metadata.

methods.name: Dequeue(spdy::SpdyFrameType*, std::unique_ptr<SpdyBufferProducer>*, base::WeakPtr<SpdyStream>*, MutableNetworkTrafficAnnotationTag*)
methods.description: Removes and returns the highest priority pending write from the queue.

methods.name: RemovePendingWritesForStream(SpdyStream*)
methods.description: Removes all pending writes associated with a specific stream.

methods.name: RemovePendingWritesForStreamsAfter(spdy::SpdyStreamId)
methods.description: Removes all pending writes for streams with IDs after a specified last good stream ID.

methods.name: ChangePriorityOfWritesForStream(SpdyStream*, RequestPriority, RequestPriority)
methods.description: Changes the priority of all pending writes for a specific stream.

methods.name: Clear()
methods.description: Clears all pending writes from the queue.
